description: Implement the full Notifications page replacing the existing placeholder in src/pages/Notifications.tsx. The page has a main content area (header, category tabs, filter bar, notification list table with pagination) and a right sidebar (notification summary donut chart, priority breakdown, recent unread, notification preferences, quiet hours).
steps: Replace the entire contents of /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany/dashboard/src/pages/Notifications.tsx with the full implementation

Define static mock data arrays at the top of the file for: notification rows (12 items with all fields), summary donut chart data (5 segments), priority breakdown data (3 items), recent unread items (4 items)

Import required icons from lucide-react: Bell, Search, Filter, ChevronDown, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, MoreHorizontal, AlertTriangle, ArrowDown, Bot, GitBranch, AlertCircle, Brain, FileText, AtSign, UserPlus, Shield, Rocket, Server, Database, Settings
Import PieChart, Pie, Cell, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer from recharts
Implement page header with Bell icon + 'Notifications' title, subtitle text, 'Mark all as read' outlined button, and red 'Notification Settings' button
Implement category tabs as pill/badge buttons: All (12, blue bg active), Unread (8), Mentions (2), Alerts (3), System (5)
Implement filter bar with search input, three dropdowns (All Types, All Modules, All Priorities), and Filters button

Implement notifications table with columns NOTIFICATION and TIME, containing 12 rows each with: colored avatar circle with icon, bold title, description text, module badge (colored), priority indicator dot with label, time ago text, and more-options button
Implement pagination bar: 'Showing 1 to 12 of 148 notifications', page buttons (< 1 2 3 ... 13 >), '10 / page' dropdown
Implement right sidebar Notification Summary card with donut chart (center text '148 Total'), legend showing 5 categories with counts and percentages
Implement Priority Breakdown card with three rows: High (red, 23, 16%), Medium (orange, 56, 38%), Low (green, 69, 46%)
Implement Recent Unread card with 4 items showing colored dots and timestamps, plus 'View all unread (8)' link
Implement Notification Preferences card with 4 settings rows (Email: Enabled green, Push: Enabled green, Slack: Disabled red, Manage Preferences link)
Implement Quiet Hours card showing '10:00 PM - 7:00 AM (Daily)' with edit link and description text
Use the same layout pattern as Activity.tsx: outer div with flex gap-4, flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-6 for main content, w-80 flex-shrink-0 space-y-4 for sidebar
Use dark theme color tokens: dark-bg, dark-surface, dark-card, white/[0.08] borders, text-white for primary text, text-gray-400 for secondary, text-gray-500 for metadata
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in dashboard/ completes with zero TypeScript errors
The Notifications.tsx file exports a Notifications component (named export)
All 12 notification rows from the spec are present with correct titles, descriptions, modules, priorities, and times
The donut chart uses recharts PieChart/Pie/Cell components with correct data
The page layout uses flex gap-4 with main content and w-80 sidebar
All text uses appropriate dark theme colors (white, gray-400, gray-500)
Module badges have distinct colors per module type
Priority indicators use colored dots (green for success/low, orange for medium, red for high)
